scope: R3 only: separate raw-scale Q2 explanation supplement. Do not replace standardized-target historical Q2, Q1 Extra Trees, or Q3; no causal or safety certification.
response: R2 balanced individual 0..6 rating distribution and median decision. GBR fits weighted raw-record quantile 0.5; Ridge fits balanced panel means (equivalent weighted squared raw-record loss), a different functional used as a linear comparator.
features: Same 224 inputs as R2; strict eligible pool is the same 219 analytes as historical Q2, with bitterness/IBU only in the 220-candidate family supplement.
gbr_selection: One global GBR depth in each outer training set by inner-OOF R2 raw-rating MAE over 50 targets after rounding/parent cap. Ties follow candidate order. Reuse R2 fixed tree parameters, not its output models.
ridge_preprocessing: Unique training beers only: median imputation, RobustAsinh, StandardScaler. Fixed alpha reproduces the historical method, now with raw balanced means and R2 predictors.
attribution: Exact interventional Tree SHAP on held-out beers, background sampled without replacement from unique outer-training beers only, model_output=raw, approximate=False. Explains the unrounded/unclipped GBR 0.5-quantile output, not Q1 ET or the final rounded/hierarchy-capped grade. Additivity tolerance 1e-6.
linear_attribution: Exact independent-background contribution beta_j*(transformed_x_j-background_mean_j); sum plus base equals the unrounded Ridge mean response. Same background beer IDs as GBR.
ranking: GBR by equal-beer mean absolute OOF SHAP; raw Ridge by equal-fold mean absolute standardized training coefficient. Stable ties in feature order, exclude scores <=1e-12, leave unfilled slots rather than rank zero effects.
direction: Marginal Spearman between original input coordinates and OOF attribution, with missing pairs omitted; descriptive association, not a monotonic concentration intervention effect.
modules: Per-outer-training unique-beer imputed Spearman absolute-rho graph, connected components. Module attribution sums signed contributions before taking mean absolute magnitude. Modules can differ between folds; keep membership and per-fold top ranks, do not multiply feature scores by centrality.
stability: Three outer refits only: per-fold top3 membership frequencies, fold-pair top3 Jaccard and importance-rank Spearman. Not bootstrap selection probabilities or task5 repeated nested validation.
prediction_support: Per-target descriptive support only when raw MAE improvement over outer-training pooled median is >=0.01 and its fixed-OOF paired style-stratified beer-bootstrap 95% lower bound >0. Else weak_predictor_exploratory_only. Fifty target intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted. Even supported targets cannot certify causality or migration control.
literature: Carry existing task3 literature only on exact target+field matches, show unreviewed for other pairs. Do not transfer old standardized-target permutation p/BY q/bootstrap frequencies to new raw-target ranks.
unlabelled: Keep A_acetaldehyde and F_acetaldehyde rank slots empty; no expert labels, no imputed chemical-proxy label.
evaluation_scope: Post-R2/R2b development on the same 250 beers. No external independent test; no full-data deployment model or Q3 optimization.
